status: WRITTEN source-independent sufficient criterion for T2-dual on a general nonnormal region, UNREVIEWED; strengthens the earlier 11:01 criterion without changing any frozen review
finding: For traceless A,B∈M4(C), define a=||A||F²,b=||B||F²,p=Tr[(A†A)²],q=Tr[(B†B)²],z=Re(conj(Tr A²)Tr B²). Then T2 holds whenever 14(p+q)+7z≤8(a²+b²)+2ab, strictly whenever < and X≠0. This includes a nonempty open region with both A² and B² nonnormal, by perturbing tracezero high-effective-rank matrices while keeping the strict inequality.
proof: Let H=X†X, X=A⊗I+I⊗B; write T=TrH=4(a+b), M=TrH²=4(p+q)+4ab+2z. For its 16 nonnegative eigenvalues h_j and mean T/16, Cauchy–Schwarz against the zero-sum vector that equals 7/8 on the two largest positions and −1/8 on the remaining 14 gives h1+h2≤T/8+sqrt[(7/4)(M−T²/16)]. This is ≤T/2 whenever M≤T²/7. Substituting the exact traces gives precisely 14(p+q)+7z≤8(a²+b²)+2ab. The condition is strictly weaker than the earlier M≤T²/8 sufficient condition; that earlier proof remains correct. No selected q-value or source input is used.
limits: The criterion covers only a subset of the both-square-nonnormal region; it does not prove full T2/T3, give an exhaustive equality classification, or confer review/parent/formal/family/novelty/operational acceptance. No frozen f196/f153/f62 scope changed; no held input.
